_comment: handoff: SessionEnd appends one block to the instance's log file (config/handoff.yml, log_file).
With no log file named the hook does nothing. It never blocks. Hook input it cannot read (another
host's shape) ends quietly with exit 0; a fault of this instance (config, log file) is exit 1 with
the cause on stderr. The session is over when it runs, so it cannot ask the model for a handoff;
it records which handoffs the session saved, or that it saved none.
The projector merges this into the host settings under a _projected_by tag; nobody edits
